messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled config-only rollout 1762712345 for route /v1/generate. Changes: batching.window=8->6, max_batch_size=32->24, routing weights adjustment, generation timeout 12s->10s. Change window: 2026-03-22 02:00-04:00 UTC. Canary: 5% for 10m. Rollout plan below.

sam: Quick question — is canary cohort the usual internal-cohortA or new tag? Tag me if anything odd.

lisa: Using internal-cohortA. I also want to pin model v2.1.3 for Dedicated tenants during rollout to avoid variant swaps. Exclude enterprise-payments and legal-compliance from the canary.

jordan: Observability gating added: p99 latency increase >10% OR error rate increase >0.5% absolute -> automatic abort. Dashboards: /dash/route-gen, /dash/kvcache. Alerts: #oncall-p99, #oncall-errors.

maria: I'll watch KV-cache pressure + token throughput. If KV pressure >65% during canary we hold and investigate. I'll post snapshots every 5m.

ops-oncall: Rollback plan pre-approved. Command to rollback config: `deploy-bot rollback-config 1762712345`. Who will run the unpin if we need full revert?

ben: I'll be on-call for the rollout window and will run rollback/unpin if needed. Also confirming Dedicated shaper unaffected? We should explicitly exclude the shaper pool for enterprise-payments.

lisa: Added exclusion list to config. Snippet pushed to deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: Applying canary -> cohortA (5%). Starting canary now. Will report status every 2m.

deploy-bot: [LOG] canary_start 1762712345 cohort=internal-cohortA percent=5
deploy-bot: [LOG] routing_update applied -> {default:70%, cohortA:30%} (canary overlay)

jordan: First 2m check: p99 +2%, errors stable. :thumbsup: Continue.

maria: KV-cache pressure 42% (ok). Token throughput steady.

deploy-bot: [LOG] canary_progress 1762712345 elapsed=10m status=complete

jordan: Canary complete. p99 overall +6%, error rate +0.05% absolute. Within gates. Proceed to staged ramp -> 30% for 30m.

sam: Ack. Ramp increments: 30% -> 70% -> 100% with 15m soak between steps. Abort conditions as above.

deploy-bot: Rolling to 30% now.

deploy-bot: [LOG] ramp 1762712345 percent=30

jordan: Mid-ramp snapshot: p99 +7%, errors +0.07%. KV pressure 48%. still safe.

maria: KV-cache threads at 50% utilization; monitoring.

ben: If we need to abort quickly: `deploy-bot rollback-config 1762712345 --force` then `config unpin route:/v1/generate`. I have creds ready.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 70% -> initiating.

deploy-bot: [LOG] ramp 1762712345 percent=70

jordan: p99 hovering +9%, errors +0.15%. No abort. Proceed to full after 15m unless we hit gates.

deploy-bot: Finalizing rollout -> 100% in 10m increments.

deploy-bot: [LOG] rollout 1762712345 percent=100 status=success 

sam: Great job team. Leaving post-deploy notes for release notes: "Config-only: reduced batch window and size to optimize tail latency; adjusted routing weights to shift 30% traffic to cohortA for improved cost-efficiency; lowered generation timeout to 10s. Excluded enterprise-payments & legal-compliance. Canary: 5% x10m; staged ramp to 100%. Gating: p99 +10% or error rate +0.5% triggers rollback."

lisa: Added notes to the release doc and flagged for follow-up: validate quality regressions on long-sequence prompts.

maria: Saved metric snapshots to ops S3: s3://redwood-prod/rollouts/1762712345/*.

ops-oncall: Closing handoff. If any customer-side regressions reported, escalate to eng-runtime and tag this thread.

ben: :party-parrot: nice and smooth.
